capabilities: View incomplete tasks grouped by day in a timeline pane or embedded note block
Filter tasks by free text, status, tags, and due dates
Create, complete, reopen, and quick-edit tasks through the TaskNotes API
Reschedule tasks by dragging them onto another day
Show calendar events from ICS, Google, and Microsoft feeds
extras: The manifest carries Obsidian's 'not manually reviewed' warning. Calendar events are read through feature-detected TaskNotes services because there is no public Runtime calendar namespace yet; a missing or incompatible TaskNotes API shows an error instead of scanning the vault.
intentEvidence: Companion plugin for TaskNotes that shows an agenda-style Today's Timeline
problem: TaskNotes has no day-agenda view that groups incomplete tasks by date, shows overdue/unplanned stats, and allows quick rescheduling and creation in one place.
